title: Most rooms label every exit with its destination, e.g. 'go south (toward the south track)', but The South Track listed bare 'go south' and 'go in' with no destination hint. 'go in' there actually leads backward to Camp Gallows rather than onward to Gullhaven, which cost a wasted turn going the wrong way before I found the correct 'go south' to continue.
where: The South Track, Thornwold (route to Saltkerns/Gullhaven)
